powerScore.heading: PowerScore Breakdown
powerScore.signalsNormalizedNote: Re-scaled to maintain 0–100 range with signals disabled
powerScore.tooltipSignalsNormalized: When signals are turned off, the remaining signals are scaled up proportionally so the score keeps its full 0–100 range.
powerScore.clockFrozenNote: game clock frozen — {before} → {after} pts before bonuses
powerScore.tooltipCloseness: Scored from the current point margin. A tie earns the most; wider margins score progressively lower. The ceiling scales with how far into the game you are, so the same margin is worth more late than early.
powerScore.tooltipLateGame: Combines how far into the game we are with how close the score is. Builds linearly across the final period. Blowouts score almost nothing here regardless of time. Adds extra points when the game is tied in the closing seconds, anticipating overtime.
powerScore.tooltipMomentum: Measures net scoring for one team across the recent score history window. If a team has outscored the other by a set amount during that stretch, this scores up. Decays toward zero as time passes without further scoring.
powerScore.tooltipLeadChanges: Counts how many times the lead has switched in the tracked history window. No changes scores nothing; one or more flips score progressively higher. Decays if time passes without another change.
powerScore.tooltipComeback: Compares the score margin at the oldest point in the window to the current margin. If the trailing team has closed the gap, this scores based on how much ground they've made up. Worth more later in the game; decays if scoring stops.
powerScore.tooltipClockStallPenalty: Applied when the game clock has barely moved across multiple consecutive data pulls. Reduces the signals subtotal by a multiplier, which deepens the longer the clock stays frozen.
powerScore.tooltipVolatility: Based on how close the live win probability has stayed to 50% over recent history. Games where it hovered near 50% (neither team with a clear advantage) earn a boost. Games where it consistently sat far from 50% in either direction are docked.
powerScore.tooltipFavoriteBoost: Added when one of your saved favorite teams is in this game. Having two favorites in the matchup adds more than one.
powerScore.tooltipGameBoost: Points you've manually applied to this game using the game boost control.
powerScore.tooltipScoringOpportunity: Added based on active scoring position. In football this is the red zone; in baseball and softball it scales with the number of runners on base.
powerScore.tooltipPostseasonBoost: A flat bonus applied to postseason games: playoffs, conference finals, and championships.

onboarding.allSetSubtitle: Want a quick tour before you dive in?

teamPicker.title: Pick your teams
teamPicker.explainer: Favorites get a scoring bonus so ArenaSwap favors those games.

tabControl.title: Welcome to ArenaSwap
tabControl.subtitle: Before we set things up, here's what to expect.
tabControl.feature1Body: ArenaSwap takes over the browser window when active. When a game heats up, ArenaSwap activates that tab even if you're watching something else.
tabControl.feature2Body: Open each stream in its own tab, then assign it to a game from the extension. ArenaSwap only touches tabs you've registered.
tabControl.feature3Body: Pause auto-switching anytime. Tune sensitivity and cooldown from Settings.

walkthrough.allSetSubtitle: Ready to always watch the best game?

stepToggle.title: Turning it on & off
stepToggle.subtitle: One switch controls everything.
stepToggle.bodyAfterOn: , ArenaSwap automatically switches your tabs to the most exciting live game. Toggle it off any time to take back control.

stepPowerScore.title: Meet PowerScore
stepPowerScore.subtitle: The heartbeat of ArenaSwap
stepPowerScore.introBody: PowerScore evaluates every live game dynamically to find the most exciting action. Let's see what goes into the formula!
stepPowerScore.closenessMeasured: Measured by point difference, weighted by game progress.
stepPowerScore.lateGameMeasured: Measured by period, time remaining, and score margin.
stepPowerScore.momentumMeasured: Measured by rolling net scoring spikes, decaying over time.
stepPowerScore.leadChangesMeasured: Measured by count of lead flips in the history window.
stepPowerScore.comebackMeasured: Measured by margin reduction in the history window.
stepPowerScore.clockStallPenaltyMeasured: Applied when the game clock freezes for multiple updates, reducing the signal subtotal.
stepPowerScore.volatilityMeasured: Boosts games with win probability hovering near 50%, penalizes steady blowouts.
stepPowerScore.favoriteBoostMeasured: Added when one of your saved favorite teams is in the matchup.
stepPowerScore.gameBoostMeasured: Points manually applied by you to temporarily prioritize a specific game.
stepPowerScore.scoringOpportunityMeasured: Added automatically for red zone drives (football) or runners on base (baseball/softball).
stepPowerScore.postseasonBoostMeasured: A flat bonus applied to playoff, conference final, and championship games.

stepTabAssign.title: Assign tabs to games
stepTabAssign.subtitle: ArenaSwap only touches tabs you register.
stepTabAssign.body: Open each stream in its own browser tab, then use the dropdown on a game card to link them. ArenaSwap will only switch to tabs you've assigned.

stepAutoSwitch.title: Watch it work
stepAutoSwitch.revealBody: The 76ers game heated up (PowerScore 89). ArenaSwap detected it and switched automatically. No clicks needed.

stepSettings.title: Tune it your way
stepSettings.subtitle: Open Settings any time to adjust.
stepSettings.sensitivityHelp: Controls how big the PowerScore gap must be before ArenaSwap switches tabs.
stepSettings.cooldownHelp: Sets the minimum time between automatic switches to reduce rapid tab flipping.

stepGameDetail.title: Dive into any game
stepGameDetail.subtitle: Tap a game card to see what's driving its score.
stepGameDetail.detailPreviewCaption: Score charts and full signal history are also available.
stepGameDetail.body: Tap any live game card to open the detail view. You'll see a full breakdown of every signal contributing to its PowerScore, plus a chart of how the score has evolved over time.
stepGameDetail.bodyAfterTap: You'll also find a manual Game Boost slider to temporarily prioritize any game you want.

stepLeaguesFavorites.title: Leagues & favorites
stepLeaguesFavorites.subtitle: Two different ways to shape what ArenaSwap watches.
stepLeaguesFavorites.leaguesExplain: Enabling a league tells ArenaSwap to look for live games in that competition. Only enabled leagues count toward auto-switching.
stepLeaguesFavorites.leaguesBody: Turn on every league you want to track in Settings → Leagues. The more you enable, the wider the net ArenaSwap casts for exciting action.
stepLeaguesFavorites.favoritesExplain: Starring a team gives its games a PowerScore bonus whenever that team is playing, making them more likely to win the automatic switch.
stepLeaguesFavorites.favoritesBody: Star your favorite teams on any game card or in Settings. It's not a filter. All games still show up; your teams just get a small boost.
stepLeaguesFavorites.favoritesBonusHint: Favorite teams active. Their games get a PowerScore boost!

stepReAccess.title: Coming back here
stepReAccess.subtitle: The tour is always one tap away.
stepReAccess.body: Hit the ? button in the top bar any time to replay this tour. It works even after setup. Handy if you want a refresher or want to show a friend how it works.

standbyGuide.title: Standby Stream
standbyGuide.subtitle: A fallback for the slow moments.
standbyGuide.quietBody: When every game you're watching drops below your threshold, ArenaSwap parks on your standby stream automatically.
standbyGuide.returnTitle: It comes back on its own
standbyGuide.returnBody: The moment any game heats back up above your threshold, ArenaSwap switches you right back.
standbyGuide.chooseBody: Open any stream you want in a tab, then pick it from the dropdown in Settings.
standbyGuide.thresholdBody: Choose how low scores need to drop before standby kicks in. Lower is more patient; higher triggers sooner.
standbyGuide.designateBody: Open your standby stream in a tab, come back here, and pick it from the dropdown.

empty.leaguesCopy: ArenaSwap needs at least one league selected before it can find games to swap between.

favoriteTeamBonus.label: Favorite team bonus
favoriteTeamBonus.explainer: Applied once for each favorited team in a game. If both teams are favorited, the bonus is doubled.

postseasonBoost.label: Postseason boost
postseasonBoost.explainer: Added to every game classified as postseason (playoffs, tournaments, knockout rounds).

general.t0: Toggle the switch in the top right to pause ArenaSwap without losing your settings.
general.t1: ArenaSwap works best with two or more game tabs open at once.
general.t2: Click any game card to dive into its PowerScore breakdown.
general.t3: Mixing sports? Enable extra leagues in Settings to swap across all of them at once.
general.t4: Giraffes and hedgehogs are cool. So is watching every game at once.
general.t5: ArenaSwap works better the longer you let it run!
general.t6: Turn on switch notifications in Settings to get an alert every time ArenaSwap changes your tab.

main.t0: Star your favorite teams to pin their games to the top of the list.
main.t1: Assign a tab from the dropdown beside each game so ArenaSwap knows where to swap.
main.t2: A higher PowerScore wins the swap; keep an eye on the colored badges.
main.t3: Turn on "Show upcoming games" in Settings to pre-assign tabs before the game starts.
main.t4: No live games yet? Demo Mode in Settings lets you watch ArenaSwap work with fake games.
main.t5: Standby Stream keeps a backup tab playing whenever every game goes quiet — enable it in Settings.

setup.t0: Lower the Cooldown to swap more aggressively during chaotic finishes.
setup.t1: Bump the Favorite Team Bonus to make sure your team almost always wins the swap.
setup.t2: Increase Switch Delay to give yourself a beat before the tab actually changes.
setup.t3: Demo Mode runs simulated games, perfect for tuning sliders without waiting for live action.
setup.t4: Sensitivity controls how big a PowerScore lead is needed before ArenaSwap swaps.
setup.t5: Postseason Boost gives playoff and championship games extra weight so the biggest moments win more switches.
setup.t6: Use the PowerScore Signals section to disable any signal you don't care about — ArenaSwap rescales everything automatically.

detail.t0: PowerScore mixes closeness, late-game pressure, momentum, lead changes, and comebacks. Then it applies a volatility boost or penalty based on how much the win probability swings.
detail.t1: A clock-stall penalty kicks in when the game clock barely moves between updates.
detail.t2: 0-0 games take a small PowerScore hit in sports where 0-0 isn't exciting.
detail.t3: Hover the charts to inspect specific moments in the game.
detail.t4: A favorite team in the matchup adds bonus points to the PowerScore.
detail.t5: PowerScore builds as a game goes on. An early close game ramps up toward the final buzzer.
detail.t6: Tied in the final minute? PowerScore pre-boosts likely overtime so you never miss the buzzer.
detail.t7: Enable betting odds in Settings to see live lines alongside each game's PowerScore.

reviewPrompt.title: Enjoying ArenaSwap?
reviewPrompt.copy: A quick review helps more fans find the best game ❤️

cooldown.label: Switch cooldown
cooldown.explainer: Sets the minimum time between automatic switches to reduce rapid tab flipping.

switchDelay.label: Switch delay
switchDelay.explainer: Waits this long before executing a switch, which helps when streams lag behind live data.

sensitivity.label: Switch sensitivity
sensitivity.explainer: Controls how big the PowerScore gap must be before ArenaSwap switches tabs.
